summary.intent: Clarify the scope of the 'Unify folder-state ownership in SDK client' todo (whether it includes web-app changes), then correct a stale/misleading ROADMAP description of Phase 47 requirement (1).
summary.outcome: Confirmed the todo does include web-app changes targeting two leaking file hooks; clarified the goal is single-writer folder state (not zero sdk-core imports); corrected ROADMAP Phase 47 requirement (1) to describe the real cure (eliminating bypasses + deleting reconcileFolderState) rather than the band-aid it previously described. Change committed and pushed on the docs/roadmap-phases-46-47-desktop-sdk branch.

repo: The todo 'unify-folder-state-ownership-in-sdk-client' explicitly targets three bypass paths in the web app where sdk-core folder-publish functions are called directly, bypassing the SDK client's sequence bookkeeping and event emission.

The 'good' pattern already exists in useFolderMutations: routes create/delete/move/rename through getSdkClient() + ensureFolderRegistered, and folder.store.ts:209 projects folder:updated events into Zustand.
client.reconcileFolderState at sdk-provider.ts:108 is a known band-aid that will become dead code once the bypass paths are eliminated — its deletion is an explicit deliverable of this todo.

sdk-core remains a legitimate web dependency for non-folder-state operations (crypto, raw uploads, file-metadata fetch/decrypt); the restriction is only on functions that mutate folder children/sequence.

code.finding: Directly imports and calls replaceFileInFolder and updateFolderMetadataAndPublish from @cipherbox/sdk-core — a bypass path that must be replaced with new SDK client methods (client.replaceFile(), client.updateFileMetadata()).
Directly calls updateFolderMetadataAndPublish and updateFileMetadata from sdk-core — another bypass path requiring migration to SDK client methods.
client.reconcileFolderState is wired here as a band-aid; will become dead code and should be deleted once bypass paths in useFileVersions and useFileOperations are eliminated.
Projects folder:updated events into Zustand — this is the correct/canonical pattern that the todo aims to make the sole writer of folder children/sequence state.

workflow: Shell glob patterns can be silently eaten by zsh expansion; using ripgrep directly avoids this class of silent failure when inventorying file references.
ROADMAP descriptions can drift from intent over time (describing a band-aid rather than the intended cure); validating against the source todo and current code caught the discrepancy.

friction: Initial bash glob for inventorying sdk-core usage was eaten by zsh and returned no results, requiring a retry with ripgrep.
open_items: Implement new SDK client methods (client.replaceFile(), client.updateFileMetadata()) that own publish + sequence bookkeeping + folder:updated emission internally.
Migrate useFileVersions.ts to use the new client methods instead of calling sdk-core folder-publish functions directly.
Migrate useFileOperations.ts to use the new client methods instead of calling sdk-core folder-publish functions directly.
Make useFolderStore a pure projection: children/sequenceNumber written only via folder:updated events, never from web mutation code.
Delete client.reconcileFolderState once the bypass paths are eliminated (it will be dead code by construction).
